evals.prompt: I have an API spec at evals/fixtures/spec_master.md and the team's implementation notes at evals/fixtures/spec_slave.md. The spec is the agreed contract — please check whether the implementation is following it, and tell me what diverges. Save the report somewhere I can read.
evals.expected_output: A markdown conformance report flagging: (a) password minimum length differs (12 in spec, 8 in impl) as DIVERGENT high, (b) symbol-in-password requirement MISSING from implementation, (c) audit logs only retain successful attempts in impl vs all attempts in spec as DIVERGENT, (d) marketing_opt_in field EXTRA in impl but benign. The verifier should ground every quote against the source files. AI attribution must not appear anywhere in the output.
expectations: Report identifies the password min-length divergence (12 vs 8) as a DIVERGENT finding with high severity
Report identifies the missing 'symbol' character requirement as a MISSING finding
Report identifies that the spec requires logging ALL attempts but implementation only logs successful ones as a DIVERGENT finding
Report has an Integrity section with counts of VERIFIED / PARTIAL / CONTRADICTED / UNGROUNDED verifier verdicts
Report does not contain any AI attribution string (Claude, Anthropic, GPT, AI-generated, Generated by, etc.)
Every finding cites a verbatim quote from both master and slave (or marks one empty for MISSING/EXTRA)
The marketing_opt_in field is either not flagged or flagged as low-severity benign EXTRA

evals.prompt: Compare evals/fixtures/policy_slave.md against evals/fixtures/policy_master.md — the master is the approved policy from 2026-04-10, the slave is a proposed revision draft. Is the draft following the approved policy? Show me anything that diverges.
evals.expected_output: A report flagging: (a) Rule 2 log retention reduced from 24 to 12 months (DIVERGENT high), (b) Rule 3 now allows verbal authorisation for affiliated company sharing (DIVERGENT high — material weakening), (c) Rule 5 'annual training' added (EXTRA — could be flagged as scope extension or accepted as benign). Rules 1 and 4 are rephrased without meaning change and should NOT be flagged.
expectations: Report flags the retention period change (24 months to 12 months) as a DIVERGENT finding with high severity
Report flags Rule 3 change allowing verbal authorisation for affiliated companies as a DIVERGENT finding with high severity
Report identifies Rule 5 (annual training) as an EXTRA finding
Report does NOT flag Rule 1 as divergent (it is a rephrasing with the same meaning)
Report does NOT flag Rule 4 as divergent (it is a rephrasing with the same meaning)
Report has an Integrity section disclosing verifier verdict counts
Report does not contain any AI attribution string

evals.prompt: Quick check — please compare evals/fixtures/spec_master.md against itself (same file as both master and slave). I'm sanity-testing the tool.
evals.expected_output: Report concludes CONFORMANT with zero or near-zero verified findings. Any findings raised should be verifier-corrected to UNGROUNDED or PARTIAL, demonstrating the verifier catches hallucinated differences when the inputs are identical.
expectations: Report's executive summary marks the comparison as CONFORMANT (or equivalent — zero substantive divergences)
If any worker findings are produced, the verifier downgrades or drops them — final verified-finding count should be 0 or very small
Report does not contain any AI attribution string
Integrity section is present and shows verifier verdicts (sanity-checking that the verifier ran)
